mapper.update: UPDATE ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common a, ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_discount_goods b SET a.common_is_xian = 0 WHERE a.common_id = b.common_id AND NOW() > b.goods_end_time AND b.discount_goods_state = 1 AND a.common_is_xian = 3
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_discount_base SET discount_state = 2 WHERE NOW() > discount_end_time AND discount_state = 1
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_discount_goods SET discount_goods_state = 2 WHERE NOW() > goods_end_time AND discount_goods_state = 1
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_discount_base SET discount_state = 4 WHERE discount_state = 0 AND NOW() BETWEEN pre_start_time AND discount_start_time
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_discount_goods SET discount_goods_state = 4 WHERE discount_goods_state = 0 AND NOW() BETWEEN pre_start_time AND goods_start_time
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_discount_base SET discount_state = 1 WHERE discount_state IN (0, 4) AND NOW() BETWEEN discount_start_time AND discount_end_time
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_discount_goods SET discount_goods_state = 1 WHERE discount_goods_state IN (0, 4) AND NOW() BETWEEN goods_start_time AND goods_end_time

UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark SET STATUS = 2 WHERE STATUS = 0 AND detail_id IN ( SELECT pd.detail_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd ON pd.pintuan_id = pp.pintuan_id WHERE NOW() > pp.end_time AND pp.STATUS = 1)

UPDATE ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common a, ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together b SET a.common_is_xian = 0 WHERE a.common_id = b.common_id AND NOW() > b.end_time AND b.STATUS = 1 AND a.common_is_xian = 4
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together SET status= 0 WHERE NOW() > end_time AND status = 1

UPDATE ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common a, ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_reduction_policy_base b, ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_reduction_policy_goods c SET a.common_is_xian = 0 WHERE b.promotion_id = c.promotion_id AND a.common_id = c.common_id AND NOW() > b.end_time AND b.promotion_status = 1 AND a.common_is_xian = 5
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_reduction_policy_base SET promotion_status= 0 WHERE NOW() > end_time AND promotion_status = 1

UPDATE ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common a,${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods b SET a.common_is_xian = 0 WHERE a.common_id = b.common_id AND NOW() > b.goods_end_time AND b.seckill_goods_state = 1 AND a.common_is_xian = 2
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods SET seckill_goods_state = 2 WHERE NOW() > goods_end_time AND seckill_goods_state = 1
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_base SET seckill_state = 2 WHERE NOW() > seckill_end_time AND seckill_state = 1
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods SET seckill_goods_state = 1 WHERE NOW() >= goods_start_time AND seckill_goods_state = 0

UPDATE ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common a, ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods b SET a.common_is_xian = 2 WHERE a.common_id = b.common_id AND NOW() >= b.goods_start_time AND b.seckill_goods_state = 0 AND a.common_is_xian = 0
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_base SET seckill_state = 1 WHERE NOW() >= seckill_start_time AND seckill_state = 0
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together SET status= 1 WHERE NOW() > start_time AND status= 2
UPDATE ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_reduction_policy_base SET promotion_status = 1 WHERE NOW() >= start_time AND promotion_status = 3
update ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common set common_is_xian = #{commonIsXian} where common_id = #{commonId}
mapper.delete: delete from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_config where id = #{id} and config_type != 1
mapper.select: SELECT pm.mark_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark pm LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd ON pd.detail_id = pm.detail_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp ON pp.pintuan_id = pd.pintuan_id WHERE ( pm.`status` = 0 AND NOW() > DATE_ADD( pm.created_time, INTERVAL pp.start_hour HOUR ) ) OR ( pm.`status` = 0 AND NOW() > pp.end_time )

SELECT count(pd.detail_id) FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd ON pd.pintuan_id = pp.pintuan_id WHERE NOW() > pp.end_time AND pp. STATUS = 1
select common_id as commonId,sum(seckill_num) as seckillNum from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods where seckill_goods_state = 1 group by common_id,shop_id,seckill_id
